descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks - Managing the sales outlet in accordance with the objectives, instructions and guidelines - Ensuring the implementation and compliance with quality standards - Ensuring process organization and readiness to sell - Planning and implementing sales promotion measures - Personnel recruitment and deployment planning - Management and support of subordinate employees - Key figure analysis - Administration
• Requirements - Completed basic training in retail, initial experience in a similar function is an advantage - Management experience - Customer-oriented thinking and acting - Very good knowledge of German - High level of commitment and motivation - Motivation/willingness for training and further education - flexibility in terms of work assignments The training takes place in several sales outlets within the following area: Sense Oberland region (canton of Friborg). After a training period of one to two years and the appropriate internal training, you will run one of our sales outlets independently.

• Exigences administratives - Formation de base terminée dans le commerce de détail, une première expérience dans une fonction similaire est un avantage - Expérience de gestion - Pensée et action orientées client - Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand - Haut niveau d'engagement et de motivation - Motivation/volonté de formation et de perfectionnement formation - flexibilité dans les affectations de travail La formation se déroule dans plusieurs points de vente du territoire suivant : Région Sense Oberland (canton de Fribourg). Après une période de formation d'un à deux ans et une formation interne adaptée, vous dirigerez en toute autonomie l'un de nos points de vente. Ce que nous proposons - Avantages : - Conditions de travail : - Horaires de travail : - Formation continue : - Durabilité : - Communication : - Santé : Votre interlocuteur Monika Fasnacht HR Marketing

• Requisiti amministrativi - Formazione di base completata nel commercio al dettaglio, una prima esperienza in una funzione simile è un vantaggio - Esperienza dirigenziale - Pensare e agire orientato al cliente - Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca - Elevato impegno e motivazione - Motivazione/disponibilità a formazione e perfezionamento - flessibilità negli incarichi lavorativi La formazione si svolge in diversi punti vendita nel seguente territorio: regione Sense Oberland (cantone di Friburgo). Dopo un periodo di formazione di uno o due anni e un'adeguata formazione interna, gestirai in autonomia uno dei nostri punti vendita.
